verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an A/B testing guide for comparing two agent versions side by side to measure prompt, model, or configuration changes, by selecting both runs on the Results page and comparing them metric by metric. Re-running the same scenarios across models and in CI on every change supports regression catching. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison view, and detail on automatic regression flagging or per-conversation diffs beyond two-run metric comparison.
